blocks.text: Unexpected expenses can test even the best-laid plans. The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas’ 2025 Consumer Finance and Inclusion Survey found that only 30% of Filipino adults said their current finances or savings would last, while 48% said it would be very difficult to come up with emergency funds, highlighting the importance of being financially prepared for unexpected situations. For Jean Henri Lhuillier, President and CEO of Cebuana Lhuillier, preparedness should go beyond physical precautions. “Being ready means looking beyond what we can anticipate and preparing for what we cannot.
